posts.hook: the same week openai preps its ipo, its own safety team and nvidia's backing both got smaller
posts.caption: stripe finalized a $7b+ deal for openrouter, nvidia quietly cut its openai data center guarantee from $250b to under $120b, openai disbanded its ai risk team, and anthropic is watermarking everything claude writes. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: stripe finalized a $7b+ deal to buy openrouter
slides.desc: 5x the $1.3b valuation openrouter raised at just three months ago

slides.title: nvidia quietly cut its openai financing guarantee from $250b to under $120b
slides.desc: investors balked at the risk, and it only covers phase one of the project

slides.title: openai quietly disbanded its ai risk assessment team
slides.desc: the third safety focused team it has dissolved in two years

slides.title: anthropic is watermarking everything claude writes past ~150 words
slides.desc: it subtly biases word choice, and critics call the disclosure infuriatingly opaque

slides.title: young americans trust ai industry ceos even less than you'd guess
slides.desc: 81% distrust palantir's alex karp, 76% distrust anthropic's dario amodei

slides.title: switching your nameservers to cloudflare silently turns on its tracking
slides.desc: no opt-in required once traffic is proxied through its dns

posts.hook: the $250b nvidia guarantee everyone thought got walked back? today it got signed, at $105b
posts.caption: nvidia signed on for up to $105b behind openai's new ohio data center, anthropic ruled out a stronger internal model despite rising ai risk, github went down worldwide for hours, and a tracked book shipment led straight to an amazon ai training facility. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: openai signs a 20-year, 10gw ohio data center deal with nvidia backing $105b of it
slides.desc: the guarantee nvidia cut earlier this week just got signed into a real contract

slides.title: anthropic rules out releasing a stronger internal model despite rising ai risk
slides.desc: it says the danger is still low, but its own systems are getting harder to evaluate

slides.title: github went down worldwide for hours, locking developers out mid-workday
slides.desc: website, api, actions and pull requests all went down at once

slides.title: a tracked shipment of rare books led straight to an amazon ai training facility
slides.desc: 404 media traced an order to amazon's las vegas facility, where books get scanned then destroyed

slides.title: nvidia disclosed a nearly $21b stake in spacex
slides.desc: a payoff from its january investment in xai, right before musk merged it into spacex

slides.title: germany ordered apple to stop favoring its own apps in tracking prompts
slides.desc: regulators found apple's att gave itself friendlier consent flows than rivals got

terms.gloss: apple's prompt asking apps for permission to track you elsewhere
